Web App

Winston

Winston is an internal company-wide admin platform built to run the full back-office of a multi-company studio. It handles quotes, invoices, business expenses, and contracts end-to-end, with PDF generation and export throughout. On top of that, it features an AI-powered LinkedIn content pipeline that automatically generates and publishes professional posts from news articles using GPT-4o-mini. Multi-company support means the same dashboard manages all entities under the studio umbrella.

Features

  • Quotes, invoices, and business expense management
  • Contract creation and tracking
  • PDF generation and export for all documents
  • Multi-company management from a single dashboard
  • AI LinkedIn post generation from articles (GPT-4o-mini)
  • Direct LinkedIn publishing via OAuth
  • Firebase Authentication and Firestore backend
  • Serverless Cloud Functions architecture

Technologies

Flutter Web Dart Firebase OpenAI GPT-4o-mini LinkedIn API Cloud Functions
